inputs.utterance: Create a calc to compute the number of business days between first and last order dates

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: {(DATEDIFF('day', [First Order Date], [Most Recent Order Date]) - (7 - DATEPART('weekday', [First Order Date])) - DATEPART('weekday', [Most Recent Order Date])) / 7*5 + MIN(5, (7 - (DATEPART('weekday', [First Order Date])))) + MIN(5, (DATEPART('weekday', [Most Recent Order Date]) - 1)) - 1}
